reset.title: Reset your password

verify.bannerText: We sent a link to {{email}}. Until then you can browse, but not post, comment, chat or add friends.

verify.dialogHint: Can't find it? Check your spam folder or ask for another one.
verify.sentDetail: We sent a new link to {{email}}.
verify.doneDetail: You can now post, comment, chat and add friends.
verify.notYetDetail: Open the link in the email and try again.
verify.sendFailedDetail: Your account was created, but we couldn't send the verification email; you can resend it from the notice.
